opening.argument: The presentation is structured as a token-launch demonstration: connect a wallet, create a token, set up liquidity, and launch. It also shows the launch interface and explains settings for a volume bot, then walks through removing liquidity. The speaker claims substantial daily returns from this method, but the supplied material does not establish realized gains, losses, or effects on other participants. The bot and liquidity instructions raise risks worth recognizing; they remain part of an operational walkthrough rather than proof of those outcomes.

citations.quote: Connect wallet, forge token, ignite liquidity, and launch.
Now go ahead & click Launch Volume Bot. Approve the transaction.
Select your pool, slide it all the way to 100%, and click on Remove Liquidity.
This is exactly how i'm generating around $35,000 per memecoin launch daily.
